# Jubilees Chapter 38 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 38:3 — "great fire" / miraculous element

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a great fire went out before Jacob and burned up" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "A great fire went out before Jacob and consumed" | "Consumed" is stronger and more precise |
| PNEUMA | "A wall of fire blazed out from before Jacob" | Dynamic; adds "wall of fire" not in Ge'ez |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "A great fire went out before Jacob and consumed." PNEUMA's "wall of fire" is an elaboration not present in the source text; "went out before" preserves the directional sense.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 38:6 — Judah's shot — anatomical detail

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "shot Esau in the right breast" | Literal; "right breast" is the Ge'ez anatomical specification |
| LOGOS | "shot Esau in the right breast" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "put an arrow through Esau's right chest" | "Chest" substituted for "breast" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "right breast." The Ge'ez is anatomically precise; "breast" here means the chest/breast area. "Chest" is a modern equivalent but loses the specificity.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 38:14 — Shiloh oracle rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "until he comes whose it is" | Follows Ge'ez/LXX; ambiguous pronoun |
| LOGOS | "until he comes whose it is — and to him shall be the obedience" | Same, clarifies the pronoun |
| PNEUMA | "until the one to whom it belongs arrives, and the nations come to obey him" | Expansive dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The oracle is a famous crux (Gen 49:10 "Shiloh" or "until tribute comes to him"). The Ge'ez favors the relative clause rendering ("whose it is") rather than "Shiloh" as a place name. LOGOS preserves both clauses of the oracle faithfully.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
